---
title: "Link Previews for Quarto"
---

Hover over an internal link to see a preview of the target page, in the style
of [Quartz](https://quartz.jzhao.xyz/) digital gardens.

Try it: read about [the coffee-ring effect](demo/coffee.qmd), skim
[a long page](demo/long-page.qmd), or jump straight to
[a section deep inside it](demo/long-page.qmd#pinned-contact-lines).

External links like [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) are left alone.
